key.name: playback-speed
key.description: Playback speed multiplier, without pitch correction.

key.name: artwork-in-sidebar
key.summary: Show playback artwork in the sidebar
key.description: Show the playing song's album art enlarged at the bottom of the sidebar instead of in the playback bar.

key.name: shuffle
key.description: Restore the shuffle setting when the application starts.

key.name: last-song
key.description: Song metadata restored paused when the application starts.

key.name: sync-url
key.description: WebDAV server used to sync the library and saved songs. Empty when sync is not connected.

key.name: sync-username
key.description: Username for the sync server. The password is stored in the system keyring.
